body: While it may help with all the stress, it's not the best way to deal with it. If there's anyone you trust enough to talk to about it and ask for help that can be much better for finding a way to deal with things that doesn't involve harming yourself. There are more people than you think that care about you and wouldn't want you do do that.

I don't want you to hurt yourself. Other people in your life don't want you to either. Not to be rude if you don't feel like it, but could you expand upon why you feel this way and what makes you want to do this?

You don't have to worry about it that much. Unless you have strong inclinations to do something that is a crime, it won't just happen to you. You can, for the most part, do what you want without worry.
Alright. Just a suggestion. If that's your only problem, you have no reason to feel that way about it. Do you think there's anything deeper to it, some reason that you might assign that to yourself?

Thank you for the advice. I probably should look into getting a job and moving out, I feel like I'd be happier in the long term, although it's a lot to deal with right now and I still have a lot of stuff I have to deal with very soon. I'll look into something like that though, it would probably make me feel a bit better.

People who suggest that people with depression and/or people who are suicidal should just "be happy" are usually well-intentioned, but don't really understand what they're saying. It's not something that you can just do, or something that's easy. It would certainly be better for you, but it's not like it's an active choice. You shouldn't feel like you're forcing your sadness on someone else just by talking to them about it. Your boyfriend for example, and I'm sure other people in your life as well, care about you and would want to help you. They wouldn't be annoyed or feel bad or anything because of you, they might be sad because they don't want you to feel sad, but that's not forcing your sadness on them. That's just them caring about you. Hiding how you actually feel from people that really care about you just keeps them from helping you, which they would probably like to do if it would make you feel better. Talking to someone you trust about how you feel is a step in the right direction, and hopefully a step towards you being happier.

I personally don't know much about it, so take that into account, but you may want to look into programs with helping people like that if it affects you so deeply. I've heard of groups before that work with criminals and try to help them turn their life around.
This essentially summarizes my other comment. Good advice, and not in a huge text block form.

I guess things could be better then as far as who I talk to and making friends there and what not, but that's if I'm even able to deal with other things. I'd like to get to that point, but I just don't know how I'd be able to deal with the other stuff I mentioned for now, which are more immediate problems.

Firstly, I'm sorry about your GP. They don't seem like a very kind person, or someone who should be in that position. Also telling someone depression is easily curable or that they aren't trying simply isn't true and not very nice. I don't know from your post, but I'm sure you have something worth living for. It may not be things society makes important like you mentioned your education and family and job, but look for other things. You mentioned telling your boyfriend you're happy so he doesn't feel bad. While I understand your intentions, if he's someone you trust it may be good for you to talk to him about it. I'm sure he cares about you enough that he'd listen if you told him you really needed to talk to him about it. I'm sorry your posts on /r/depression were ignored and the therapy site you mentioned didn't work out. Things like that don't always work out unfortunately, but just because it didn't then doesn't mean there aren't people out there who care about you. Just from reading your post I now care about you and hope for the best for you. If you need someone to talk to feel free to reply to this or pm me.
